test_accounting: Qualification runs use the clean committed source revision, including the newer main CLI reader changes. Development repeats and subsequent ledger checks are excluded; no executed tests ignored. WASM totals are taken from runner logs; four related native-only cases are absent from that configuration, not ignored.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of committed Git blob bytes
implementation: After exhausting forward progress within the header, retain the first non-undefined numeric default error through the shared failed-pass temperature contract. Keep unresolved defaults symbolic without publishing numeric placeholders.

Keep successful default sampling isolated, formal scope ownership, authored per-instance expressions, and authoritative duplicate selection unchanged. Independent later declarations can select TEMP/TNOM, but a fresh source pass must validate the selected header defaults before publication.

An undefined derived default no longer masks a concrete domain failure in another default. Stable invalid defaults remain fatal when the definition is unused, overridden by an instance, or redefined in the body. Existing terminal resource/cancellation priorities and finite replay budgets remain unchanged.
acceptance_evidence: Ten portable regressions cover resistor/source bodies, TEMP and forward TNOM discovery, derived defaults, nested formal ownership in ngspice and Xyce dialects, instance overrides, duplicate selection, intermediate-header progress, stable syntax/domain errors, inactive/cyclic hints, exact statistical phases, resource priority, and included continuation origins.

Independent DC expectations: 1 mA through 1/2 ohm instance values produces 1/2 mV within 1e-12 V; derived voltage defaults and overrides produce 2/6 V within 1e-10 V. Existing MOS, diode and capacitor override tests also pass.
Private tests cover every observed cancellation boundary during sampled/derived-header recovery, with no subsequent polls after abort, and physical TEMP override precedence.
limits: Root IC/NODESET voltage hints can still fail at the provisional temperature before later TEMP discovery. Other earlier card failures, eager parameter error classes and general statistical/runtime binding remain open.
Inner-loop cancellation, allocation/performance bounds and broader qualification remain open. No C00-C14 package closes.
Prior Rust 1.94/1.95 compiler and native WASM-runner reliability incidents remain C14 work; these results do not establish general toolchain reproducibility.
